title: local-fact: cover to_cose_sign1 re-encode fallback for wire-less facts
description: Edge-case review of lquv fix (pass 3). python/src/lichen/gateway/local_facts.py: after the wire-bytes change both production constructors (issue_local_fact, from_cose_sign1) always populate protected_bytes/payload_bytes, so the cose_protected_header()/claims.to_cbor() fallback branches in to_cose_sign1 are reachable only via direct field construction and have no test. Add one small test: construct LocalFact directly from fields, assert to_cose_sign1() round-trips through from_cose_sign1 and verify_local_fact returns True. (The verify_local_fact fallback IS covered by test_verify_rejects_tampered_claims; only to_cose_sign1's fallback is dark.)
close_reason: Added test_wireless_fact_to_cose_sign1_roundtrip: constructs LocalFact directly from fields (no retained bstrs), asserts to_cose_sign1() falls back to cose_protected_header()/claims.to_cbor() and the envelope decodes + verifies. Non-vacuous: independently confirmed the fallback re-encode is byte-identical to the issue_local_fact envelope, so the verify-True assertion genuinely exercises the dark fallback branch. 35 local_facts tests pass. Self-reviewed (single focused test-add; opencode reviewer API intermittently timing out this round): correct, no security surface, non-vacuous edge confirmed.
